Then the LORD said to Moses,
And the Lord said to Moses,
耶和華曉諭摩西說：

「你要吩咐以色列人說：『獻給我的供物，就是獻給我作馨香火祭的食物，你們要按日期獻給我』；
And tell them that this is the offering made by fire you are to present to the LORD as a regular burnt offering each day: two unblemished year-old male lambs.
Say to them, This is the offering made by fire which you are to give to the Lord; he-lambs of the first year without any mark, two every day as a regular burned offering.
又要對他們說：你們要獻給耶和華的火祭，就是沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔，每日兩隻，作為常獻的燔祭。
Offer one lamb in the morning and the other at twilight,
Let one be offered in the morning, and the other at evening;
早晨要獻一隻，黃昏的時候要獻一隻；
along with a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with a quarter hin of oil from pressed olives.
And the tenth part of an ephah of the best meal for a meal offering mixed with the fourth part of a hin of clear oil.
又用細麵伊法十分之一，並搗成的油一欣四分之一，調和作為素祭。
This is a regular burnt offering established at Mount Sinai as a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
It is a regular burned offering, as it was ordered in Mount Sinai, for a sweet smell, an offering made by fire to the Lord.
這是西奈山所命定為常獻的燔祭，是獻給耶和華為馨香的火祭。
The drink offering accompanying each lamb shall be a quarter hin. Pour out the offering of fermented drink to the LORD in the sanctuary area.
And for its drink offering take the fourth part of a hin for one lamb: in the holy place let the wine be drained out for a drink offering for the Lord.
為這一隻羊羔，要同獻奠祭的酒一欣四分之一。在聖所中，你要將醇酒奉給耶和華為奠祭。
And offer the second lamb at twilight, with the same grain offering and drink offering as in the morning. It is an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
Let the other lamb be offered at evening; like the meal offering of the morning and its drink offering, let it be offered as an offering made by fire for a sweet smell to the Lord.
晚上，你要獻那一隻羊羔，必照早晨的素祭和同獻的奠祭獻上，作為馨香的火祭，獻給耶和華。」
On the Sabbath day, present two unblemished year-old male lambs, accompanied by a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, as well as a drink offering.
And on the Sabbath day, two he-lambs of the first year, without any mark, and two tenth parts of the best meal for a meal offering mixed with oil, and its drink offering:
「當安息日，要獻兩隻沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔，並用調油的細麵伊法十分之二為素祭，又將同獻的奠祭獻上。
This is the burnt offering for every Sabbath, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
This is the burned offering for every Sabbath day, in addition to the regular burned offering, and its drink offering.
這是每安息日獻的燔祭；那常獻的燔祭和同獻的奠祭在外。」

「每月朔，你們要將兩隻公牛犢，一隻公綿羊，七隻沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔，獻給耶和華為燔祭。
along with three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering with each bull, two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering with the ram,

每隻公牛要用調油的細麵伊法十分之三作為素祭；那隻公羊也用調油的細麵伊法十分之二作為素祭；
and a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering with each lamb. This is a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
And a separate tenth part of the best meal mixed with oil for a meal offering for every lamb; for a burned offering of a sweet smell, an offering made by fire to the Lord.
每隻羊羔要用調油的細麵伊法十分之一作為素祭和馨香的燔祭，是獻給耶和華的火祭。

Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine with each bull, a third of a hin with the ram, and a quarter hin with each lamb. This is the monthly burnt offering to be made at each new moon throughout the year.

And their drink offerings are to be half a hin of wine for an ox, and the third part of a hin for a male sheep, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb: this is the burned offering for every month through all the months of the year.
一隻公牛要奠酒半欣，一隻公羊要奠酒一欣三分之一，一隻羊羔也奠酒一欣四分之一。這是每月的燔祭，一年之中要月月如此。
In addition to the regular burnt offering with its drink offering, one male goat is to be presented to the LORD as a sin offering.
And one he-goat for a sin-offering to the Lord; it is to be offered in addition to the regular burned offering and its drink offering.
又要將一隻公山羊為贖罪祭，獻給耶和華；要獻在常獻的燔祭和同獻的奠祭以外。」
The fourteenth day of the first month is the LORD’s Passover.
And in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is the Lord's Passover.
「正月十四日是耶和華的逾越節。
On the fifteenth day of this month, there shall be a feast; for seven days unleavened bread is to be eaten.
On the fifteenth day of this month there is to be a feast; for seven days let your food be unleavened cakes.
這月十五日是節期，要吃無酵餅七日。
On the first day there is to be a sacred assembly; you must not do any regular work.
On the first day there is to be a holy meeting: you may do no sort of field-work:
第一日當有聖會；甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。
Present to the LORD an offering made by fire, a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old, all unblemished.
And you are to give an offering made by fire, a burned offering to the Lord; two oxen, one male sheep, and seven he-lambs of the first year, without any mark:
當將公牛犢兩隻，公綿羊一隻，一歲的公羊羔七隻，都要沒有殘疾的，用火獻給耶和華為燔祭。
The grain offering shall consist of fine flour mixed with oil; offer three-tenths of an ephah with each bull, two-tenths of an ephah with the ram,

and a tenth of an ephah with each of the seven lambs.
And a separate tenth part for every one of the seven lambs;
為那七隻羊羔，每隻要獻伊法十分之一。
Include one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you.
And one he-goat for a sin-offering to take away your sin.
並獻一隻公山羊作贖罪祭，為你們贖罪。
You are to present these in addition to the regular morning burnt offering.
These are to be offered in addition to the morning burned offering, which is a regular burned offering at all times.
你們獻這些，要在早晨常獻的燔祭以外。
Offer the same food each day for seven days as an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD. It is to be offered with its drink offering and the regular burnt offering.
In this way, every day for seven days, give the food of the offering made by fire, a sweet smell to the Lord: it is to be offered in addition to the regular burned offering, and its drink offering.
一連七日，每日要照這例把馨香火祭的食物獻給耶和華，是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的奠祭以外。
On the seventh day you shall hold a sacred assembly; you must not do any regular work.
Then on the seventh day there will be a holy meeting; you may do no field-work.
第七日當有聖會，甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。」
On the day of firstfruits, when you present an offering of new grain to the LORD during the Feast of Weeks, you are to hold a sacred assembly; you must not do any regular work.
And at the time of the first-fruits, when you give an offering of new meal to the Lord at your feast of weeks, there is to be a holy meeting: you may do no field-work:
「七七節莊稼初熟，你們獻新素祭給耶和華的日子，當有聖會；甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。
Present a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old as a pleasing aroma to the LORD,

together with their grain offerings of fine flour mixed with oil—three-tenths of an ephah with each bull, two-tenths of an ephah with the ram,

and a tenth of an ephah with each of the seven lambs.
